qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the chain sprocket to injection pump?
What is the torque value for the toothed belt pulley to injection pump?
What fastener type is specified for the toothed belt pulley to injection pump?
What is the torque specification for the chain tensioner?
Which component has the highest torque specification in the injection pump drive section?
qa_pairs.answer: The toothed belt pulley to injection pump at 50 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What fastener type is used for the chain tensioner?
Which two components use the same fastener type M51/M41?
qa_pairs.answer: The toothed belt pulley to injection pump and the chain tensioner

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between the chain sprocket and toothed belt pulley connections?
qa_pairs.answer: 3 Nm (toothed belt pulley is 50 Nm, chain sprocket is 47 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: What section of the service manual does this torque specification table belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: 13-5 Fuel delivery and metering system, specifically 13 52 Injection Pump Drive
